Check the current round's dates, city, featured generals and eligibility in game.
Follow the round-specific requirements and claim or redeem rewards before its deadline.
rewardStatus: Specific rewards pending verification from the individual announcement.

Review the current round's participation rules and reward milestones.
Complete eligible activities and claim rewards before the event closes.

name: Running of the Bulls 2026
summary: A seasonal event announcement that included Alliance Carnival, Wheel of Dragon War and Alchemy Shop activities.
steps: Open the Event Center and check which associated activities are active.
For Alliance Carnival, obtain event items from eligible activities and exchange earned currency in its shop.
For Alchemy Shop, complete daily tasks and spend event currency before it expires.
rewards: Alliance Carnival: Shield of Glory and Sword of Justice can be exchanged for Sakura Castle decoration, featured generals and skins; availability depends on earned points and shop inventory.
Wheel of Dragon War: possible wheel prizes include Dragon Pattern Chest, Excellent Dragon Coins and Gems; Dragon Soul Leaves come from event packages.
Alchemy Shop: Molten Ore from daily tasks can be exchanged for Alchemical Coins toward featured Monarch avatars, including Plague Physician, and Azure Capital castle decoration.
King’s Party: milestone rewards include Civilization Scroll Chests and Officer Equipment Scroll Chest; purchasing Gems is required to gain Party Cake experience.

name: Fire Festival 2026
summary: Seasonal activities included Voyage to Civilizations, Wheel of Dragon War and Shopping Spree.
steps: Open the current event panels to check which activities are available.
Review the task and exchange requirements for each activity.
Use limited-time event items before the announced conversion or expiration.
rewards: Voyage to Civilizations: Golden Ship Wheel gives a chance at the Elixir Furnace ornament and Golden Commemorative Coins; coins can be redeemed in the Civilization Museum.
Wheel of Dragon War: wheel prizes include Dragon Pattern Chest, Excellent Dragon Coins and Gems; spins require Dragon Soul Leaves from packages.
Alchemy Shop: daily tasks earn Molten Ore for Alchemical Coins; exchange options include Plague Doctor and other Monarch avatars and Azure Capital decoration.
King’s Party: milestone rewards include Civilization Scroll Chests, officer equipment scrolls and a choice of Egg Garden ornaments; Party Cake experience comes from Gem purchases.

name: Starry Pilgrimage 2026
summary: The announced event included Stars and Earth, Ode to Eran and Plague of Carrion Flies.
steps: Open Event Center → Starry Pilgrimage when the event is available.
Collect the activity items specified by the current event panel.
Review the redemption period separately from the point-earning period.
rewards: Eran Collection: Sacred Flame Points unlock milestones and ranking rewards; featured prizes include Ancient City Gor – Lingering Flame decoration and Banu Goshasp champion skin.
Ode to Eran: Bull-Headed Maces earned from monsters, resource spots or packages can yield a Starry Pilgrimage Historic General Chest with a choice including Rostam.
Stars and Earth: participation can award up to 20 Bull-Headed Maces; Haoma for the storyline comes from Normal or Elite Nasu or packages.
Voyage to Civilizations: chance to obtain Sirius Rite ornament and Golden Commemorative Coins for Civilization Museum exchanges.
King’s Party: milestone rewards include Turan Strongbow, a Tishtrya general skin and Philippa; Party Cake experience comes from Gem purchases.

name: Viking Festival 2026
summary: An officially announced Viking Festival round. Check in-game details for the rules of the current iteration.
steps: Check the event center for the current Viking Festival activities.
Review the event tasks, participation rules and reward requirements.
Claim rewards before the event ends.
rewards: Divination of Fate: use Fate Cards from monster kills, gathering or purchases for a random prize; the featured prize is Moon Goddess – Artemis general skin.
Rainbow Crow Voyage: obtain Spiritual Beast Scales from bosses or packages, then exchange them for Rainbow Crow Token to unlock the Rainbow Crow spiritual beast.
Voyage to Civilizations: Golden Ship Wheel offers a chance at Coronation Fountain ornament and Golden Commemorative Coins for exchanges.
King’s Party: milestone rewards include Great Sailing decoration, Civilization Scroll Chests and Margaret of Valois; Party Cake experience comes from Gem purchases.
